data.name: Battle Drive
data.detailed_description:
Battle Drive is an Action-Adventure Game where you must complete challenges in hostile environments to earn a living and build your own custom vehicle that will ultimately be your weapon against the apocalypse.

Survive by relying on your skills, strategies and reflexes to overcome natural disasters, nefarious opportunists and PVE challenges that continue to escalate in the build up towards the impending Catastrophe

Progress through the story of a former first-responder turned driver for hire, utilizing numerous vehicles, play styles and tactics to endure the gauntlet of chaos constantly being thrown into your path. 

Make alliances and enemies with NPCs, Factions or other players in a variety of missions and play modes, taking on the risks and responsibilities of every choice you make. 

Battle Drive focuses on an anti-meta game design principle, where you are encouraged to play to your strengths to overcome procedurally generated challenges, so that every playthrough is a unique experience, before ever even entering the challenging and chaotic online arena.
